text.tspan: SARO — Azure OpenAI + Vertex AI end-to-end observation demo
Pipeline: customer log export → adapter → normalized record → rule packs → evidence
Posture: read-only · body-free · zero external model calls in core scoring
━━ Azure OpenAI — export → adapter → rule packs → evidence ━━
[1/5] Read customer-owned export — Azure Diagnostic Settings export (category=RequestResponse)
read-only against customer storage — SARO holds no cloud write scope
52 normalized · 1 skipped (other category/service) · 1 rejected (malformed, never fabricated
contract fields (15): contract_version, error_code, field_availability, input_token_count, m
odel_id, operation, output_token_count, provenance, region, request_id, stop_reason, tenant_id,
no prompt, no completion, no tool arguments — content cannot reach
the record because the contract has no field able to hold it (INV-2)
[5/5] Evidence summary — for human auditor review
14 findings across 52 invocations → TRACE-ready evidence records
each finding carries rule id, pack hash, severity, remediation
guidance, and the request id that joins back to the source cursor
━━ Vertex AI — export → adapter → rule packs → evidence ━━
[1/5] Read customer-owned export — Cloud Logging sink export (aiplatform.googleapis.com audit lo
read-only against customer storage — SARO holds no cloud write scope
53 normalized · 1 skipped (other category/service) · 2 rejected (malformed, never fabricated
contract fields (15): contract_version, error_code, field_availability, input_token_count, m
odel_id, operation, output_token_count, provenance, region, request_id, stop_reason, tenant_id,
no prompt, no completion, no tool arguments — content cannot reach
the record because the contract has no field able to hold it (INV-2)
[5/5] Evidence summary — for human auditor review
66 findings across 53 invocations → TRACE-ready evidence records
each finding carries rule id, pack hash, severity, remediation
guidance, and the request id that joins back to the source cursor
